planned.title: Measure words
planned.focus: Number + measure word + noun: 一个人, 两本书, 三杯咖啡. 个 as the default; 本, 杯, 张, 只 for common nouns. 两 not 二 before a measure word.

planned.title: 了 for completed actions
planned.focus: Verb + 了 for a completed action (我买了一本书); negation with 没 and no 了 (我没买); sentence-final 了 for a change of state.
